On 10.11.2022, following order was passed :
"Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and perused the record.
State is represented through learned A.G.A.
Learned counsel for the applicants is permitted to make necessary amendment in the memo of parties during the course of the day.

This Criminal Misc. Application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed to quash the entire proceedings in case no.17897 of 2021 (State vs. Faisal and others) under Faisal And 3 Others vs State Of U.P And Another on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136943817/
1 sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act & section 3/4 of Muslim Womens (Protection of Rights on Divorce Act), 2019, P.S. Kotwali, District Meerut pending in the court of ACJM, court no.1 Meerut.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have entered into a compromise as a subject matter of the dispute was matrimonial.

sentences.text: The terms and conditions have been entered into a compromise which is annexure no.3.
The parties shall appear before the trial court within three weeks and file the compromise.
The trial court after due identification, verify the compromise.

The trial Judge shall forward to this Court a duly verified copy of the compromise entered into between the parties along with a copy of his order verifying the compromise which shall be before the next date fixed.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive steps shall be taken against the applicant in the aforesaid case crime.

Office will ensure the compliance of the aforesaid order and will transmit the copy of the compromise along with copy of the order to the trial court through the concerned Session Judge within three days."
2.
In compliance thereof, the parties have appeared before the learned court below and verified the settlement reached between them on 25.8.2022.

That fact has been duly recorded in the order dated 29.11.2022 passed by the In-Charge, Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Meerut, Court No. 1,
Meerut in Case No. 17897 of 2021.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The terms and conditions have been entered into a compromise which is annexure no.3.
The parties shall appear before the trial court within three weeks and file the compromise.
The trial court after due identification, verify the compromise.
The trial Judge shall forward to this Court a duly verified copy of the compromise entered into between the parties along with a copy of his order verifying the compromise which shall be before the next date fixed.
List on 14.12.2022 as fresh.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive steps shall be taken against the applicant in the aforesaid case crime.
Office will ensure the compliance of the aforesaid order and will transmit the copy of the compromise along with copy of the order to the trial court through the concerned Session Judge within three days."
2.
In compliance thereof, the parties have appeared before the learned court below and verified the settlement reached between them on 25.8.2022.
That fact has been duly recorded in the order dated 29.11.2022 passed by the In-Charge, Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Meerut, Court No. 1,
Meerut in Case No. 17897 of 2021.
Thus, it has been submitted that matrimonial discord has been resolved.
3. Considering the above, no useful purpose would be served in keeping the present application pending any further.
The application is allowed.
